observations: Sony PlayStation 4 Slim console with a camouflage skin sticker.
Two wireless controllers in retail boxes.
One power cable with a UK-style plug.
The console is shown from the front and top.
The background shows a glass display case and other electronics.

claims.evidence: The console in photo 0 is a Sony PlayStation 4 Slim.
The console is shown from the front and top; the back and sides are not visible.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and a clear image on an external screen.

risks.risk: The internal storage capacity (500GB vs 1TB) is unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the storage size.

risks.risk: The controllers may be third-party clones rather than original Sony models.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the controllers showing the model number and Sony logo.

risks.risk: The console may have a 'blue light of death' or other hardware failure.
risks.proof: A video of the console running a game or the system menu.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the back of the console showing the model number and ports.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the storage capacity.
Video of the console powered on and connected to a TV.
Photo of the back of the controllers to verify they are original Sony models.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
